content_of_post_to_answer: How do you maintain a positive attitude and keep moving even when your body is in pain from past injuries?
answer: Living with old injuries often requires a shift from measuring progress by what your body can no longer do to noticing how wisely you work with it now. Pain can become a constant negotiation rather than a daily defeat. The challenge is not pretending the body is fine; it is building a life that includes its limits without letting those limits become your identity. Resilience is not ignoring pain, but refusing to let pain make every decision.
